description: Create a payment route (virtual bank account) so a customer can receive fiat deposits that convert to a stablecoin and pay out to a wallet. The payout destination is mandatory: the API refuses a fiat-to-crypto route without one. Deposit handling is set server-side and defaults to auto_payout; change it afterwards with update_virtual_account.

customerId.description: The customer ID to create the payment route for

destinationAddress.description: Wallet address deposits are paid out to. Validated against the chosen network

destinationPaymentRail.description: Blockchain network the payout address belongs to

sourceCurrency.description: Fiat currency the route collects in (e.g. 'AUD', 'USD', 'EUR')

name: create_virtual_account
title: Create payment route
